findings.description: `raise cause ... from None` sets `__suppress_context__` on the underlying exception and clears nothing else useful, hiding the TryAgain link and discarding the cause's own chain display. The `from None` also mutates the cause's `__cause__` to None, destroying the original chain of the underlying exception.
findings.rationale: Trigger: the cause already has its own `__cause__` (e.g. `raise ValueError from KeyError`), and TryAgain is raised in its handler and retries are exhausted with reraise=True. `from None` overwrites the cause's `__cause__` with None and sets suppress_context, so the traceback no longer shows the original KeyError, losing debugging information.
